D-1.observed: fresh isolated profile shows 'No candidate viewed' and no auto-selection; dock shows It 1 (A,B), It 2 (C,D), It 3 (E) in authoritative order.

D-2.observed: the fixture carries five candidates, so zero/one-candidate cardinality and its stated Compare reason cannot be produced natively; covered by dock model tests and the switcher condition.

D-3.observed: click A → viewed A; click B → pair A/B, surface switches to Compare, dock marks A Compare and B Viewed·Compare·Active; with Compare active a plain click on C moves viewed to C and keeps A/B; Change B then D sets side B=D while viewed stays C.

D-4.observed: identities never disappear from the static fixture; the kept-reference and explicit-unavailable behaviour is covered by ui-model presentation tests.

D-5.observed: no compare side can disappear from the static fixture; covered by the same model tests.

D-6.observed: reappearance after disappearance cannot be produced natively; covered by model tests.

D-7.observed: Close Compare returns to the Artifact surface with the viewed candidate C and the dock markers reset; no other history is replayed.

D-8.observed: after a normal close with pair A/B and viewed B, relaunching the same isolated profile restores the Compare surface with side A=A, side B=B and viewed B; no substitution occurs.

D-9.observed: the fixture has one Task, so a native task switch cannot be observed; the clearing behaviour is covered by the presentation model tests.

D-10.observed: the timeline shows only the authoritative It 1/It 2/It 3 groups with their candidate rows; no synthesised node or locally inferred current iteration appears.

D-11.observed: application-level history belongs to DC-MP-NAV3/DD-07 and is not implemented here.

D-12.observed: focus reconciliation functions and tests exist; a native disappearance of a focused row is not reproducible in this fixture.

D-13.observed: the fixture projects no formal outcome, so no marker is shown; the protocol exhaustive test proves no formal-selection command exists.

compare_admission.observed: Ctrl+1 → Artifact, Ctrl+Tab → Compare with five candidates and the held pair intact through the shared admission path. The sub-two-candidate refusal branch is NOT_REPRODUCIBLE natively; desktop-gpui tests cover 0/1/2/3 candidates and the NextSurface forwarding.
